insights.one_liner: Chinese premium electric car maker known for battery swapping, with a recognised-sponsor Dutch entity and an English-language finance internship in Amsterdam.

culture.text: Designs and sells premium smart electric vehicles and runs a battery swapping network.
Headquartered in Shanghai; staff mostly studied at Chinese universities such as Tongji, Shanghai Jiao Tong and Fudan.
Main functions are engineering, operations, IT, business development and design.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through NIO Netherlands B.V.
Its one current opening, a finance internship in Amsterdam, does not ask for Dutch.

growth.text: Delivered 109,178 vehicles in Q3 2026, meeting guidance, though growth slowed sharply in September.
Earns more per car but is still loss-making.

worth_knowing.text: Geely is buying into NIO's battery swapping network.
